fusions.name: Heavy Breach
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles and come down on the target for 28 damage. Enemies within 3.5 tiles of the landing take 80% of that damage.

fusions.name: Mauling Mouthful
fusions.desc: A swipe and bite across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 12 damage and knocks each target back 3 tiles. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gorged Bulk
fusions.desc: Raises your maximum health by 20% for 15 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Laying On Fat
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
